4. Problem Files 
4.4. Problem Data Blocks 
4.4.8. *Radar Data Block 
*radar 2 station> 
altd12.4 long=65.345 latgdd2.435 
wgs-72 distn=25.5 distez15.2 distd=-10.3 
shows another example which defines a station relative to a WGS-72 earth model 
that is located at an altitude of 112.4 ft, a longitude of 65.34SoE, and a latitude of 
12.435"N. From this position the radar is offset 25.5 ft north, 15.2 ft east, and 10.3 
* ft up.
